name: lenfon-marketplace
description: lenfon 的个人 WorkBuddy 用户市场，收录 WPF/.NET 桌面开发技能——material-design-styles（MaterialDesignInXamlToolkit 命名样式参考与控件选型指南）、wpf-basic-template（Prism 9 + Material Design 5 标准化 WPF 脚手架）、prism-assistant（Prism for WPF 使用参考助手：MVVM / 导航 / 模块 / 对话框 / 事件聚合真实用法与避坑清单），持续扩充。源码托管于 GitHub：https://github.com/LenFon/lenfon-marketplace，可直接在 WorkBuddy 中按该地址安装。
description_en: lenfon's personal WorkBuddy marketplace hosting WPF/.NET desktop development skills — material-design-styles (MaterialDesignInXamlToolkit style reference & control pick guide), wpf-basic-template (standardized WPF scaffold with Prism 9 + Material Design 5), and prism-assistant (Prism for WPF usage reference: MVVM / navigation / modules / dialogs / event aggregation with real-world patterns and pitfalls) — and keeps growing. Source is hosted on GitHub: https://github.com/LenFon/lenfon-marketplace; installable directly in WorkBuddy from that address.

plugins.name: material-design-styles
plugins.description: MaterialDesignInXamlToolkit 命名样式（x:Key）参考与 WPF 控件样式选型指南（锁定最新稳定版 v5.3.2），按 MD2 / MD3 分组收录 405 个唯一命名样式清单，覆盖按钮、输入框、卡片等控件变体。

plugins.name: wpf-basic-template
plugins.description: 用户标准化 WPF 一键脚手架（Prism 9 + Material Design 5【默认 MD3 样式】+ CommunityToolkit.Mvvm + CPM + slnx + src 四层）。用于新建 WPF 项目 / 解决方案 / View / UserControl：scripts/scaffold.py 一条命令完成模板拷贝（26 个文件，含 .gitignore）→ 占位符替换 → git init + 首次提交，跨平台纯标准库；另附包版本核对脚本。

plugins.name: prism-assistant
plugins.description: Prism for WPF 框架使用参考助手（基于官方 PrismLibrary/Prism 与 Prism-Samples-Wpf 示例归纳的 MVVM / 导航 / 模块 / 对话框 / 事件聚合真实用法与避坑清单）。
